summary: The community package has about two major releases per year with minor releases every four weeks, and only one major version is maintained at a time; unmaintained versions may contain unfixed CVEs.
questions: How long is an Ansible community package version supported?
How often is a new major Ansible package released?
If Ansible 4 is out, will 3.x still get fixes?
Is it risky to stay on an unmaintained Ansible version?

answer_card.title: Community package support policy
answer_card.answer_md:
- About **two major** community package releases per year, trailing ansible-core.
- A **minor** release every four weeks with backwards-compatible features and fixes.
- Since 2.10 only **one** major version is maintained: when 4.0.0 ships, 3.x stops. An EOL version may get one final maintenance release.
- Unmaintained versions may have unfixed CVEs, so upgrade promptly.
